name: get_connector
description:
Retrieve a connector by its stable ID or URL-encoded team-scoped UID for the selected team.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/connect/connectors/{connector} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

connector.description: Stable connector ID or URL-encoded team-scoped UID. Examples: `scl_abc123` or `slack%2Fmy-bot`.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
